title: Flow cytometry analysis of the subpopulations of mouse keratinocytes and skin immune cells
protocol: Euthanize mice by CO2 inhalation.
Collect skin samples from the chest area immediately after euthanization.
Cut an approximately 3 cm × 4 cm area from mouse chest skin using ophthalmic scissors.
Float each skin sample in a petri dish containing 10 mL of PBS on ice while other samples are being processed.
Flip the skin sample surface-side down.
Fix the sample by pressing down on the neck side with curved forceps.
Scrape off subcutaneous tissue with another curved forceps, following the hair pattern direction.
Incubate the skin sample for 45 minutes with epidermal digestion solution.
Fix the neck side of the skin with a pair of curved forceps after incubation.
Scrape on the skin surface to detach the epidermis, following the hair direction.
Pump the cell suspension between 8 to 10 times with a 50 mL syringe.
Use the lid of the petri dish to make a slope for pumping.
Mince skin well until it gets a paste-like texture using ophthalmic scissors in 35 mm petri dishes on ice.
Pump 8 to 10 times with a 12 mL syringe.
Transfer skin samples surface-side down onto the lid of petri dishes.
Scrape off subcutaneous tissue using two forceps.
Transfer back the skin into each petri dish and float on PBS.
Float skin surface-side up on 10 mL of epidermis digestion solution in a 100 mm × 15 mm petri dish.
Remove any air bubbles under the skin samples using two curved forceps.
Incubate for 45 min at 37°C in a cell culture incubator.
Transfer the skin onto the lid of the petri dish and discard epidermis digestion solution by decanting.
Put the skin back onto the petri dish.
Pour 20 mL of 4°C 5% FACS buffer into each petri dish.
Scrape off the epidermis from the dermis gently with two curved forceps.
Discard the dermis.
Mechanically dissociate the epidermal cells with a 50 mL syringe, pumping 8 to 10 times without applying too much pressure.
Filter the cell suspensions through sterile 100 μm Falcon® Cell Strainers placed on 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL of 5% FACS buffer.
Filter the solution through sterile 40 μm Falcon® Cell Strainers placed on new 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 300 μL of 5% FACS buffer.
Transfer 1 mL of whole skin digestion solution to minced tissue.
Mince the mixture until a paste-like texture is obtained on ice.
Pour the minced skin into 6-well plates containing the whole skin digestion solution.
Incubate for 2 hours at 37°C in a cell culture incubator without CO2.
Add 1 mL of 0.25% Trypsin-1 mM EDTA to each well for the last 10 minutes of incubation.
Deactivate enzymatic reaction by adding 4 mL of cold (4°C) 5% FACS buffer to each well.
Mechanically dissociate with a 12 mL syringe, pumping 8 to 10 times without excessive force.
Filter the cell suspension through sterile 100 μm Falcon® Cell Strainers placed on 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 8 minutes at 4°C and remove supernatant.
Break the cell pellets and resuspend in 10 mL of 5% FACS buffer.
Filter again with 40 μm cell strainers placed on new 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 8 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend the cells with 300 μL of 5% FACS buffer.
Transfer 150 μL of cell suspension into a 96 v-bottom well plate.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the cells in 200 μL of PBS.
Centrifuge again and remove supernatant.
Dilute Zombie Aqua Fixable Viability Kit at a dilution of 1:200 in PBS.
Resuspend the cells with 100 μL Zombie Aqua Fixable Viability Kit solution.
Incubate at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 15 min, covered with aluminum foil.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C and discard supernatant.
Dilute anti-mouse CD16/32 antibody at a dilution of 1:200 with 5% FACS buffer.
Resuspend the cells with 100 μL Fc block solution and incubate on ice for 5 min.
During incubation, prepare a master mix solution of indicated antibodies in Eppendorf tubes or 15 mL conical tubes.
After incubation with Fc block, centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Add 100 μL of antibody master mix and incubate cells on ice, in the dark, for 25 min.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C and discard supernatant.
Wash the cells with 200 μL of 5% FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C and discard supernatant.
Repeat steps to wash the cells.
Resuspend the cells with 200 μL of 5% FACS buffer.
Keep cells stained for keratinocyte and myeloid cell panels on ice until data collection.
Optional: Fix cells by adding 200 μL of FluoroFix™ Buffer after step 37 if immediate data collection is not possible.
Incubate the cells at room temperature in the dark for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells with 200 μL of 5% FACS buffer.
Repeat steps (c) and (d).
Incubate fixed cells by adding 200 μL of 1× Foxp3 Fixation/Permeabilization working solution.
Incubate the cells at room temperature, in the dark, for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells with 200 μL of 1× Permeabilization Buffer working solution.
Incubate at room temperature, in the dark, for 15 min.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells with 100 μL of 1× Permeabilization Buffer working solution with 2% normal rat serum.
Prepare the antibody master mix for transcription factors GATA3 and RORγt in 1× Permeabilization Buffer working solution with 2% normal rat serum.
Add antibody master mix to each sample.
Incubate the cells at 4°C, in the dark, overnight (approximately 12 h).
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Wash the cells with 200 μL 1× Permeabilization Buffer working solution.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Repeat steps of washing the cells and discarding the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells with 200 μL 1× Permeabilization Buffer working solution.
Keep cells on ice until data collection.
Collect data using LSR ll or LSR Fortessa (BD Biosciences).
Analyze data by using FlowJo software (FlowJo, LLC).
Set appropriate PMT voltage and compensation before acquiring samples.
Use compensation beads (Cat# 552845, BD) for setting up compensation.
